title: The Paper Chain for the Door
youtube_title: The Paper Chain for the Door | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Teamwork is letting each person keep the part they do best.
summary: At a bakery kitchen before the early table, a paper chain long enough for the whole door will go wrong if one person rushes. Nim and Yelena split it into two slow jobs, while Ms. Okonkwo only offers a count or a name for the knot they need. They finish together.
